test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

RAIN : SZJM :: FALL : GZMK :: JUMP : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- Alternately (1) is added to and subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• RAIN : SZJM

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0a478e1a98ed54c507e225feee5585c66fdf4f1c6cdb352b9c778fa32dc6981.png] 

And,

 
• FALL : GZMK

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71615c4d1b1879d47747c4253831d72aa2d9a88f60f42c868d7533a0d2f4749e.png] 

Similarly,

 
• JUMP : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3c74d6bbe547b94feb9bd0b7438de2fe58f53b16c9d767e2144c3b87a98b6db.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**KTNO**".

4e:T
